name: 个人年度积分排名
description: 官方“个人年度排名：姓名|积分|排名”的数据源
statement: SELECT e.employee_no AS employee_no, e.employee_name AS employee_name, e.dept AS dept, e.position AS position, SUM(p.total_point) AS total_point, SUM(p.year_point) AS year_point, COUNT(p.id) AS point_count, MAX(p.rank_no) AS rank_no FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN hr_point p ON p.employee_no = e.employee_no GROUP BY e.employee_no, e.employee_name, e.dept, e.position ORDER BY total_point DESC
sql: SELECT e.employee_no AS employee_no, e.employee_name AS employee_name, e.dept AS dept, e.position AS position, SUM(p.total_point) AS total_point, SUM(p.year_point) AS year_point, COUNT(p.id) AS point_count, MAX(p.rank_no) AS rank_no FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN hr_point p ON p.employee_no = e.employee_no GROUP BY e.employee_no, e.employee_name, e.dept, e.position ORDER BY total_point DESC
